newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Top fashion show in Portugal ends in fire.
newsitem.headline: Top fashion show in Portugal ends in fire.

text.p: Fire tore through Oporto's Coliseu theatre early on Saturday morning just hours after top models Claudia Schiffer, Valeria Mazza and Yasmeen Gaurhi had appeared in a fashion show there.
The blaze, which gutted the area around the stage, forced organisers to cancel the second day of the two-day event which has become Portugal's top fashion showcase.
Nobody was hurt in the fire which broke out at 0230 GMT, a few hours after the international models had left the theatre, a fire brigade spokesman said.
Fire brigade officials said that the fire had most likely been caused by a smouldering cigarette.
